content.title: USA vs Belgium prediction: fans in Atlanta have their say
content.text: “3-2 US... let’s go!”Supporters gathered in Atlanta were optimistic but also realistic as the United States prepare for one of their most demanding tests ahead of the 2026 World Cup against ninth-ranked team in the world Belgium. With the tournament set to be staged across the U.S., Mexico and Canada, nights like this carry added weight for a team still shaping its identity under Mauricio Pochettino.Excitement at USMNT vs BelgiumThere was a clear sense of excitement around the stadium, with fans calling for intensity, attacking intent and, above all, a statement performance against top-tier European opposition. Belgium, packed with experience and quality, represents exactly the kind of challenge the USMNT will need to handle on home soil this summer.Predictions varied, but confidence in the team’s direction was evident. Some backed a narrow U.S. win, others expected a draw, but most agreed that performance matters as much as the result at this stage of preparation.Watch the full video above to hear directly from fans outside Mercedes-Benz Stadium.Get closer to the game!
